title: Development of a novel composite membrane combining polystyrene, polypyrrole, and salian for enhanced scaling prevention in water filtration applications
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, 11,422-434
DOI: 10.1039/D4EW00847B, Paper
Abeer Adaileh, Ahmed H. Ragab, Mostafa A. Taher, Muhammad Idrees Afridi, Mohamed M. Awad, Aya Elfiky, H. Selim, El-Sayed M. El-Sayed, Mahmoud F. Mubarak
A novel composite membrane, comprising polystyrene, polypyrrole, and salian (PSPPY-Sa), was developed through the electro spinning technique to enhance scaling inhibition in water filtration systems.
